method: Retrieved official current V4 scope and the actual GitHub directory index at seven research subdirectories and docs/src/tests/product. Resolved each of 36 evidence_ref paths against exact filename in owning directory; two promoted paths additionally located in research branch; no inferred local filesystem paths.
limitations: File existence does not prove scientific/methodological claim or original publisher signature.
evaluate_scope itself accepts any nonempty evidence_ref and does not check live GitHub path; research governance must review substance/sha as separate gate.
V4 progress is a versioned subjective evidential maturity review, not a cryptographically certified score.
outcome: No stale paths detected; no changes to V4, no real identity/score gate promoted.
next: B11 inspect source-eligibility and event-provenance claim gate integration tests, then prioritize actual live HTTP.
